# biznetgio_baremetal_products (Data Source)

List product NEO Metal dari `GET /baremetals/products`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "biznetgio_baremetal_products" "all" {}

output "first_product_id" {
  value = data.biznetgio_baremetal_products.all.products[0].product_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `products` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--products))

<a id="nestedatt--products"></a>
### Nested Schema for `products`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Deskripsi product.
- `name` (String) Nama product (alias name/product_name/label).
- `product_id` (Number) Product id buat `biznetgio_baremetal.product_id`.
- `raw` (String, Sensitive) Full JSON product.
